qc.label_under_test: The opening or inner pieces of a strong verdict word (good OR bad) that the tokenizer splits into several pieces, in English, Russian, German, French, Spanish or Italian, strongest right after is/was: Russian замечательный, великолепный, ужасный; German außergewöhnlich, hervorragend, atemberaubend; French extraordinaire, époustouflant, hors norme; Spanish/Italian extraordinario, straordinario, espantosa; English hyphenated verdict compounds (extra-ordinary, jaw-dropping, first-class, world-class), 'out of this world', and strong judging words in ALL CAPS (INCREDIBLE, MAGNIFICENT, HORRIBLE). Also fires on the shared opening piece in a look-alike with no verdict: German außerhalb ('outside'). Quiet on mild verdicts in any language (gut, okay, хороший, correct, normal, FINE), on strong English words written normally as one token (extraordinary, spectacular, breathtaking, incredible, remarkable), on hyphenated compounds with no verdict (first-floor), and on neutral words in caps.

neighbours.label: The opening piece of a strong verdict (good or bad) that is still unfinished, in a judging slot after is/was/a: it lights up on the first piece of a split or hyphenated verdict word or set phrase, already before the rest arrives (was truly ground-breaking, was mind-blowing, was jaw-dropping, was out of this world, a first-class job, INC-REDIBLE / HORRIBLE in ALL CAPS, German war außergewöhnlich, French était hors norme, Russian зам-ечательный). Quiet on the same opening words in literal uses (turned the ground over, a ground-floor shed, walked out of the room, changed her mind, broke his jaw), on strong verdicts written as one ordinary token (incredible, extraordinary, wonderful), on finished intensifiers (absolutely, extremely), and on mild verdicts (okay, fine, gut). Exception: German außerhalb ('outside') also fires on its opening piece.
fire: The final concert of the tour was truly ground-breaking.
Honestly, the view from the summit was mind-blowing.
Her performance in the last act was jaw-dropping.
The dessert at that little bistro was out of this world.
The renovation crew did a first-class job on the kitchen.
The movie was INCREDIBLE, I want to see it again!
That customer service call was HORRIBLE from start to finish.
Das Konzert gestern Abend war außergewöhnlich.
quiet: The farmer turned the ground over before planting the beans.
She changed her mind about the trip at the last minute.
He broke his jaw falling off his bike last summer.
The tired student walked out of the room after the exam.
They kept the tools in a ground-floor shed behind the house.
The dessert at that little bistro was wonderful.
Her performance in the last act was extraordinary.
The renovation crew did an okay job on the kitchen.

predictions: Blind label-only test. Expect most fire items above 0.3 (first-class may be near 0.2); literal near misses near zero; one-token verdicts ~0.1.
